title: Minecraft SRV Record Generator | Connect Without Port
description: Generate Minecraft SRV and A record values so players can join using a clean domain without typing a port.
intro: Generate the DNS records commonly used to let players join your Minecraft server with a clean domain name.
howTo: Enter the domain players should type, like play.example.com.
Enter the target host and actual server port.
Create the matching A/CNAME and SRV records at your DNS provider.
Wait for DNS to update and test from Minecraft.
faqs: What does an SRV record do for Minecraft?
It lets a domain point to a specific Minecraft port so players do not need to type the port manually.
Do I need an A record too?
Usually yes. The SRV target must point to a hostname that resolves to your server IP.
Bedrock DNS support differs from Java setups. This tool is mainly for Java server domain setups.
